It is not part of the native primary objective corpus under `../locked-acceptance/`.

Packet `R5.75-5.4` keeps this root placeholder-only after re-auditing candidate
`05a56cc51632982b`.

No-op rationale:

- the candidate repeats the already-locked instruction-surface / pasted-skill boundary covered by

- it also overlaps the scaffolding / anchoring honesty boundary already covered by

- the remaining uncovered behavior is that the live analyzer currently keeps the early pasted

Because Packet `R5.75-5` is fixture/harness/docs-only and must not retune objective semantics, this
candidate stays excluded until a later packet explicitly owns that later-turn retargeting problem.
